interaction_review: The owned Question is created before the synchronous answer closure. LocalAnswerer and CacheContext borrow this same Question; NameLookup remains local to answer_local_or_cached and expires before the closure returns. Reusing underlying Vec capacity across requests cannot preserve an old hint.
54bd read-only selection and owner/root/revision/generation/type/fresh checks are unchanged. Its mutable cache-answer helper still performs LRU promotion only in the original answer path.

Lease expiry runs before cached-CNAME/local eligibility. The same-name host/raw/rule/CNAME fallback and lease160→100sticky behavior retained from54bd remain exercised by the original coexistence tests.

Header parse failures precede taking the stored buffer. Question-count/decode failures restore scratch, including partial data; the next decode clears it. All Result paths inside local/cache/stale/policy/upstream work reach the final owned-Name-to-Vec recovery.

Reply packets and QueryResult are owned. Normal forwarding still parses and owns a separate Question, recipient question_name, canonical key and packet. Pending/coalesced requests retain no reference to the reusable scratch.
walk_name validation, extra4footer bounds, compression and invalid-name semantics are unchanged. TCP and other parsing entrypoints retain their original behavior.

One per-daemon buffer retains amortized capacity after warmup. Valid names fit255wire bytes; uneven label growth can retain380bytes. The original greater-than256/at-most512 fixture and partial/overlong error recovery remain, with no shrink or new reserve policy.
